# TheStatusQ

> A copywriting and web design studio run by Quinn Crowell. We build lifecycle email programs, conversion-focused websites, and video sales letter scripts for consumer brands and small businesses. Every site is built to WCAG 2.1 Level AA and verified with axe-core plus a manual keyboard pass.

TheStatusQ is a small studio, not an agency network. Quinn Crowell is the founder and does the work.

- Website: https://www.thestatusq.io
- Contact: hello@thestatusq.io
- Founder LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/quinnctsq

## What we do

- **Lifecycle email and Klaviyo.** Welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase and win-back flows built in Klaviyo, plus ongoing campaign copy. Klaviyo setup runs $300 to $500. An ongoing email copywriting retainer is $800 per month for 3 to 5 emails a week, two-month minimum.
- **Websites and landing pages.** Static and Next.js builds. A single landing page is $1,500. A starter funnel bundling a landing page, Klaviyo setup with UTM tracking and a five-email sequence is $2,200. A full package with a site, copy, a VSL script and a five-email sequence runs $3,500 to $5,000.
- **VSL scripts.** Video sales letter scripts for a specific offer.
- **Ongoing maintenance.** A $250 per month retainer covering hosting, security and three content updates a month.

## How we work

Discovery call, then a written brief, then build, then a review round, then deploy. Most single-page builds take about a week. A multi-page site takes two to four weeks depending on how fast content comes back.

## Accessibility

Every build targets WCAG 2.1 Level AA. We run axe-core across five rule sets at 1440px, 390px and 320px, on every page, plus a manual pass for keyboard order, focus visibility, 200% zoom reflow and alt text quality. We also gate PDF and Word deliverables for tags, structure tree, document language and title, because a linked menu or price list is part of the site an evaluator will judge.

We do not install accessibility overlay widgets. Overlays do not fix the underlying markup, and the FTC fined one overlay vendor $1,000,000 in January 2025 over claims that its product produced conformance.

We do not claim conformance with the ADA itself, because no such certification exists for a private-sector website. The provable statement, and the one we use, is "built to WCAG 2.1 Level AA, verified with axe-core and a manual keyboard pass on a given date."

## Government and public sector

QC Holdings, LLC is registered on SAM.gov. We can produce an Accessibility Conformance Report from the VPAT template, which most small studios bidding on public work cannot.
